texto: I finished the Web Application Development programme and I'm now in the second year of Cross-Platform Application Development at IES Lázaro Cárdenas. I'm most interested in full stack development: I enjoy learning new technologies and putting them into practice in my own projects.

500 hours of workplace training. I solved issues on the company's real projects, with branches and pull requests reviewed before merging, GitHub Projects, Conventional Commits, Husky, ESLint and Prettier.

trayectoria.texto: Full stack training: programming, databases, client-side and server-side development, interface design, deployment, computer systems and cloud architectures. I took part in entrepreneurship and project pitch competitions, developing and presenting a project made in IPE.

proyectos.descripcion: Psychology portal with a React app, a secure Express REST API and a WordPress landing page. Protected routes, roles, JWT and encryption of sensitive data.
Desktop dashboard to manage incidents: reactive indicators, search, filters and issue creation. Programmatic version and refactor to FXML + Scene Builder.
Twitch interface clone with a live stream list and player, connected to the official API.
Web portal to upload, list and manage student projects, with authentication, student and admin roles, and its own API.
My personal portfolio, with i18n, reusable components and deployment on Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages and a VPS with Docker.
Responsive, accessible (AA) one-page landing, with Grid for the layout, Flexbox for navigation and cards, and a light/dark theme.
